evidence.locator: line 1: External connector contract (J1 pin 2 input, pin 1 filtered output, pin 3 ground)
symbol J1 (at 60.96 63.5 180) wiring to labels IN (68.58, 66.04) and OUT (68.58, 63.5)
footprints[ref=J1].pads: pad 1 net /IN, pad 2 net /OUT, pad 3 net GND

decisions.reason: Verified against the saved native schematic, PCB, exported netlist, and extracted board geometry: J1 pin 1 is connected to net /IN (only R1 pin 1, the unfiltered series resistor input) and J1 pin 2 is connected to net /OUT (R1 pin 2 and C1 pin 1, the RC low-pass filtered node). This directly violates the declared external connector contract in inputs/requirements.txt requiring J1 pin 2 to be the input and J1 pin 1 to be the filtered output. The unverified claim that the pins were already fixed is contradicted by the saved candidate files.
